accepted.title: Metric removability of a deterministic vertical line in the directed landscape
accepted.text: Let L be the directed landscape and ξ(r)=0 for 0≤r≤1. For deterministic p=(x,s), q=(y,t) with 0<s<t<1, let L^g_ξ(p;q) be the supremum of L-lengths of continuous directed paths from p to q that intersect the vertical curve {(0,r):0≤r≤1} at only finitely many times. Equivalently, this is the metric gluing of the restricted landscapes on the two sides of ξ, using Definition 5.9. Is L^g_ξ(p;q)=L(p;q) almost surely for every such deterministic pair p,q?
accepted.citation: Question 5.1, printed/PDF p.161; formal metric-gluing Definitions 5.7–5.10, printed/PDF pp.163–164.
accepted.subject: Probability & Stochastic Processes

accepted.title: Hausdorff dimensions of LQG geodesic-network strata
accepted.text: Fix γ∈(0,2), a whole-plane Gaussian free field h, and its γ-Liouville quantum gravity metric D_h. Let S_k be the set of points from which k nonconstant D_h-geodesics emanate pairwise disjoint except at their common starting point. For a fixed geodesic-network graph G with its two endpoints distinguished, let A_G consist of distinct pairs (z,w)∈C² for which the union of all D_h-geodesics from z to w has network topology G. Determine the almost sure Hausdorff dimension of A_G in the product metric D_h×D_h in terms of the star dimensions {dim_{D_h}S_k}_{k≥1}, including establishing the required determinism of those star dimensions.
accepted.citation: Problem 7.49, printed/PDF p.331; star and network definitions, printed/PDF pp.326,329–331. Current paper Problem 52, arXiv:2512.09219v2.
accepted.subject: Probability & Stochastic Processes

accepted.title: Constant-probability long geodesics through the origin in dynamical exponential LPP
accepted.text: Give every vertex of Z² an independent Exp(1) weight and refresh each weight independently at rate one. At time t, let Γ_p^{q,t} be the up-right maximum-weight path between coordinatewise ordered vertices p≤q. Fix θ∈(−1,1) and ε>0, and set ℓ_{n,ε}^θ={p∈Z²:p_1+p_2=n, |p_1−p_2−θn|≤ε|n|}. Is there c=c(θ,ε)>0 such that for every sufficiently large integer n, P[there exist t∈[0,1], p∈ℓ_{−n,ε}^θ and q∈ℓ_{n,ε}^θ with p≤q and 0∈Γ_p^{q,t}]≥c?
accepted.citation: Question 8.17, printed/PDF p.352; Theorem 8.3 and segment notation, printed/PDF p.338. Associated exponential-LPP paper Question 18.
accepted.subject: Probability & Stochastic Processes
